name: @compass/workspace
description: Compass workspace root. Coordinates the bun workspace (one root bun.lock + hoisted node_modules) and pins shared dependency versions via the catalog. proto (.prototools) owns the bun/node toolchains; this catalog owns the shared package versions. The overrides are reviewed floors/pins, not floats: @tanstack/virtual-core 3.17.5 is the chat-mode scroll floor the message-surface renderer requires, and @bufbuild/protoc-gen-es is pinned exact because its version string is stamped into every generated TS header — a float would fail compass-proto:drift against the checked-in trees on the next minor.
